competitors.name: Frozen One
competitors.action: Frozen One raised $2 million in seed funding to support a nationwide retail push, including rollout into roughly 1,464 Target stores and Kroger Texas doors.

competitors.name: Blackbird Foods
competitors.action: Blackbird expanded its plant-based Pizza Minis nationwide at Sprouts, extending a convenience-led, better-for-you frozen pizza format beyond Whole Foods into another scaled natural grocery chain.

competitors.name: Buddy's Pizza
competitors.action: Buddy's new owners said they plan to grow the brand's frozen pizza presence in grocery store freezer aisles nationwide while explicitly repositioning around quality, authenticity, and Detroit heritage.

trends.topic: Frozen pizza growth is concentrating around very legible retail stories
trends.magnitude: Capital is backing high-protein positioning, natural-channel retailers are scaling plant-based convenience formats, and restaurant brands are still moving into freezer aisles with authenticity-led expansion plans.
trends.context: For Real Dough, the lesson is that broad artisan language is not enough on its own. Buyers are rewarding products that can be explained fast, whether that is protein, plant-based convenience, or restaurant-origin authenticity.

market_data.value: 4-count, 5-inch personal pizzas now at Sprouts nationwide

breaking.headline: Today's strongest signal is that frozen pizza buyers want an instantly repeatable hook
breaking.impact: High-protein, plant-based convenience, and restaurant-authenticity stories are all getting real distribution or capital. Real Dough should keep sharpening a simple retail promise that merchandisers and shoppers can understand in one sentence.
